source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: In the enemy [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), check for reduced enemy units up to 9″ from Be’lakor during Battle-shock. Those below Starting Strength must take the test. A one-model starting unit qualifies if its model is wounded. Whenever a foe within 9″ fails that test, restore up to D3 of Be’lakor’s lost wounds per failed unit.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

effects.condition: below Starting Strength or one-model starting unit with lost wounds

effects.trigger: enemy unit in range fails Battle-shock test
